newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi bourse to remain closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Delhi bourse to remain closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: The Delhi Stock Exchange will remain closed on Thursday due to the Hindu festival of Janmashtami, officials said.
Janmashtami, a festival to celebrate the birth of Hindu god Lord Krishna, is popular among Indian brokers.
On Wednesday the bourse's benchmark index closed 2.37 points higher at 792.05.
Brokers will however, trade on the National Stock Exchange which will stay open.
